decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:SuDs ProformaA120A200_Rev AA201_Rev AE3_01_Rev APP-14404379v1Design and Access Statement, dated Oct 2025 r.5Planning Statement dated Oct, 2025SuDs informationRefuse information: Palisade fencing specification sheetFire statementSecured by Design CertificateCycle storage details and specificationsReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Within 6 months of the date of the grant of planning permission, an Energy Statement detailing the renewable energy technologies, including photovoltaic (PV) panels, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall be implemented on site within 6 months of the written approval of the Energy Statement and thereafter retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO"² emission reduction targets are met, in accordance with Policy DMD51 of the Development Management Document (2014).

Details of source control SuDS hereby approved shall be implemented, retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property, in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF and to maximise opportunities for sustainable development, improve water quality, biodiversity, local amenity and recreation value.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved cycle parking and refuse details, and shall remain in place for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Borough's waste reduction targets.

The proposed development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved measures outlined in the Fire Statement (dated 21.05.25). The approved measures shall be implemented on site prior to the occupation of the development and shall be permanently maintained.Reason: In the interests of the safety of future occupiers.

That the use hereby permitted shall be carried out only by Enfield Council and the permission shall not enure for the benefit of the premises or land nor for any other person unless previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the light of the circumstances and the need to provide emergency temporary accommodation for homeless persons as outlined in the application and the supporting information which might not be applicable or appropriate if the approved hostel were to be operated by a different proprietor or in a differing manner.

The development shall be used solely to provide temporary accommodation for homeless people and shall at no time provide permanent housing for any occupants.Reason: To ensure that the development is used for the specific purpose assessed as part of this application and to enable the Local Planning Authority to retain control over the use of the site, in the interests of the proper planning of the area and to safeguard residential amenity, in accordance with the National Planning Policy Framework, Policies CP30 and CP36 of the Enfield Core Strategy and the relevant policies of the Development Management Document.
description: Permanent use of John Wilkes House for a hostel for residential accommodation for 36 single homeless men (sui generis).
